gitlink.gitlink_git_object_source: The current parent Git database stores the gitlink pointer but not its commit object; this exact archive and tree identity are reused from the previously verified immutable gitlink receipt.

transport.requirements: Verify the exact d8 source manifest, APFS-clone to a private isolated release, overlay only these two allowlisted regular files, then verify all 9,233 source and gitlink paths, modes, sizes, hashes, lock and inode isolation before Cargo.
